admission.justification: Unit tests verify strict exact-key deserialization, non-boolean type validation and timestamp-free canonical JSON, preventing silent schema drift or nondeterministic diffs in downstream validators and site banners.

applicability: All Phase 0 audit domain dataclasses and canonical JSON serialization under src/rh_pipeline/models/audit.py.
conditions: Every dataclass is frozen with slots, wraps mapping fields in sorted read-only views, and validates required/optional key sets and field types in from_dict (rejecting missing required keys, unknown extra keys, bool-as-int and int-as-bool on ComparatorSummary.enable_nanoda).

ComparatorSummary accepts optional external_kernels (default {}), definition_names (default ()) and enable_nanoda (default None) while emitting all eight sorted keys in to_dict(); VerificationStatus restricts build_status to 'unverified-locally', permits None or non-empty strings for community_verification_notes_sha256 and upstream_static_scan_sha256, and format_canonical_json emits sorted-key indent=2 JSON with a trailing newline.
exclusions: Cross-field consistency between VerificationStatus top-level counts and its nested scan summary is enforced by build_verification_status rather than from_dict.
statement: Phase 0 audit domain models are immutable frozen dataclasses with strict key-validated to_dict/from_dict deserialization (supporting optional condensed ComparatorSummary fields and nullable VerificationStatus verification-note digests) and deterministic sorted-key canonical JSON formatting without wall-clock timestamps.
title: Immutable Phase 0 audit models and timestamp-free canonical JSON
